newsitem.title: UK: Opinion poll sees Labour win in Wirral South.
newsitem.headline: Opinion poll sees Labour win in Wirral South.

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour Party is set to win the February 27 by-election in Wirral South with a 17.5 percent swing against the government, according to an opinion poll published on Sunday.

The MORI opinion poll said that 54 percent of the electorate in the north-west England constituency would vote Labour, 35 percent Conservative and 10 percent Liberal Democrat. One percent were undecided.

The Wirral South seat was held by the Conservatives with a majority of more than 8,000. A Labour win would put Prime Minister John Major's government into a minority and could hasten the date of national elections which must be held by May 22.
The MORI survey interviewed 601 adults by telephone in Wirral South on February 6 and 7.
